overview.en:
Manage Akiflow tasks, subtasks, calendars and time slots, and review meeting transcripts through its official MCP server.

Use calendar and availability context to prepare a schedule. Specify participants, time zone, and duration before suggesting meeting times or calendar changes.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Akiflow 官方 MCP 管理任务、子任务、日历与时间块，并查看会议转录。

结合日历与空闲时间准备安排，建议会议时间或日程变更前明确参会人、时区和时长。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find available times for a 30-minute meeting next week in my time zone.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 按我的时区寻找下周可用的 30 分钟会议时间。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize my upcoming schedule and identify potential conflicts.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总我接下来的日程，并识别潜在冲突。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a proposed calendar change for review before saving it.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备日历变更方案供审阅，先不要保存。
